dataify-ebay-products 1.0.0 - Initial release

- Submit Dataify eBay product collection tasks supporting four modes: product URL, category URL, keyword, and store URL.
- Guides users through mode selection and parameter entry for each collection type.
- Handles Dataify API TOKEN retrieval, use, and secure environment variable storage with user confirmation.
- Validates user inputs before submitting Builder requests.
- Provides status feedback and directs users to the Dataify dashboard for results.
